links.comparator_used: Same physicians reading unassisted (no AI), rather than AI acting alone
links.outcome: Reader diagnostic performance (AUC, sensitivity, specificity), inter-reader agreement and interpretation time for detecting fetal abnormalities on ultrasound images
links.effect: AUC 68.9% to 90.9% (mean +21.9 percentage points, p < 0.001); sensitivity 88.5% vs 54.2% (p < 0.01); specificity 87.9% vs 80.7% (p < 0.01); inter-reader agreement 72% vs 26%; interpretation time 23 vs 40 s per image
links.quote: AI assistance significantly improved reader performance in detecting fetal abnormalities without compromising specificity.

design_hint: AI assistance versus unassisted clinician reading (human-AI reader support)
